// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-directory: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface PluginDirectoryEntry {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly path: readonly string[];
    readonly kind: "file" | "directory" | "other";
    readonly size?: number;
}

export interface PluginDirectoryGrant {
    readonly grant_id: string;
    readonly root: string;
    readonly granted_at: string;
}

export interface PluginDirectoryReadRequest {
    readonly grant_id: string;
    readonly path?: readonly string[];
    readonly kind?: "directory" | "text" | "bytes";
    readonly max_bytes?: number;
}

export type PluginDirectoryReadResult = {
    readonly outcome: "directory";
    readonly entries: readonly PluginDirectoryEntry[];
    readonly truncated: boolean;
} | {
    readonly outcome: "text";
    readonly text: string;
    readonly bytes: number;
} | {
    readonly outcome: "bytes";
    readonly data: string;
    readonly bytes: number;
} | {
    readonly outcome: "too-large";
    readonly bytes: number;
    readonly limit: number;
} | {
    readonly outcome: "missing" | "denied" | "unsupported" | "changed";
};

export interface PluginDirectoryService {
    read(request: PluginDirectoryReadRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<PluginDirectoryReadResult>;
}
